cases.title: BROKEN VARIANT of R03: CD's text switch is off, so no IL texts are written (must FAIL)
cases.expected: This variant is wrong on purpose: with the switch off CD writes no IL text, so R03's count of IL texts (2) must fail. The check that exactly one new pipe was placed must PASS, which shows CD itself still ran.
cases.why_not_unit: It exists only to prove R03 can fail when the IL texts are missing.
